name: tracker-native-codex-usage
goal: Record validated Codex token totals in native managed Tracker completion receipts using the owned attempt worktree.

evidence: Native Codex completion leaves usage empty even when the launched provider recorded token counts for its owned worktree.

The managed foreground lifecycle tests only asserted outcome and state. Its existing completion case will also assert usage from one uniquely matching synthetic Codex transcript and decline ambiguous matches.
